notes: Template for new users. Automatic Mode is ON by default (user can switch to Manual). Do not treat any one user's private lists as product rules.
operating_mode_note: Automatic Mode is the default since 2026-10-16 4:01 PM PT (owner authorization). Switch to 'review' (Manual) anytime; switches are logged and affect only future cards.
session_follower_counts_note: Universal built-in standard since 2026-10-16 ~4:28 PM PT: every purge session records the start and end follower counts (read-only followers_count + timestamp). Always on and part of default setup; not a toggle. See src/session_counts.py.

candidate_card_ui.note: Product-wide default for all users (label + review note updated 2026-10-16 4:52 PM PT; source of truth: src/product_config.py).
candidate_card_ui.review_note: Unmarked accounts will be kept in review.

approval_check_note: Heads up: this is just a Grok Bot action check before I run a step. It has nothing to do with X, and it's not a flag on your account.
approval_check_note_note: Product-wide standard since 2026-10-16 4:55 PM PT: posted alongside every Grok Bot approval/safety-check card; card behavior unchanged. Source: src/product_config.py

prior_cleanup._note: Product-wide setup step (2026-10-16 ~5:32 PM PT); per-user values, isolated per user_key. Asked at initial setup: see product_config.PRIOR_CLEANUP_QUESTION.
prior_cleanup.optional_note: Optional, skippable (2026-10-16 ~5:32 PM PT). Skipped or 'never' -> first scan starts with recent batches and works backward with pacing.

graveyard_return_action_note: Graveyard returns (removed accounts that follow again) are BLOCKED, never removed again. 'review' (default) = each block needs your OK; 'auto_block' = your standing setting authorizes it.

inactivity._note: Inactive detection without an activity sample (2026-10-16). Threshold stays protection.inactivity_days_threshold. A dated last post/activity at or past the threshold = INACTIVE; zero posts on an old account or a very low lifetime post rate are hints only -> REVIEW. An activity sample, when present, takes precedence. Protections run first.

sheets.backend_note: connector (default): the bot writes with the Google Sheets connector you connect in your own Grok Bot, so the sheet is in your own Drive. google_api: advanced fallback outside Grok Bot (your own OAuth client or service-account key). csv: no sheet, CSV report only.
sheets.title: Follower Finder Log

runtime_note: Locked to Grok Bot mode: Google Sheets + Google Drive are rechecked each session; the standalone path needs its own config plus FOLLOWER_FINDER_STANDALONE=1 and is not part of this template.

review_schedule._note: v3.5.31. Presets: daily, weekdays, 3x_week, 2x_week, weekly, or custom cron (runs >= 5 min apart). See src/review_schedule.py.

terminate_reminder._note: Optional (v3.2.0, default OFF). The bot's own daily chat nudge 'Hey, want to terminate some bots?' (Yes / Remind me later / Not today). Separate from daily_scan.reminder_via_front_door. See src/terminate_reminder.py.

memory._note: v3.3.0. Your own private memory at data/users/<user_key>/memory/brain.db (starts empty; never stores secrets). Backup to a PRIVATE GitHub repo you own is optional and OFF by default; it uses your own gh login and never saves a token. See src/memory.py.
